scope: Guarded VM character-append fusion and readonly constant append lowering
reproductions: A skipped loop changed index from 9 to 3 in VM/JIT; interpreter retained 9.
Fused fractional counters errored instead of running the original loop.

implementation: Fused opcode returns a success guard; compiler retains original loop for guarded-out inputs with ordinary remappable branch instructions.
Fuse only independent mutable target/index bindings with integer counters and string target. Skip loops without assigning or inspecting the target when integer index >= limit.
Widen counter subtraction to i128 and append at most 4096 characters per dispatch, returning to cancellation checks between batches.
Readonly constant appends compile to ordinary checked assignment.
Stop advertising fused append as JIT-supported before it has native lowering; VM batching remains active.
